bounty: Monica said she'd share the bounty of her Thanksgiving feast with everyone, eventually.
bowel: Chandler made an awkward joke about his bowel after eating too much of Monica's chili.
bozo: Joey called the rude guy at his audition a bozo, then got the part anyway.
brainiac: Ross was the brainiac of the group and never once let anyone forget it.
brass: Monica scrubbed the brass doorknob until it gleamed brighter than the coffee shop windows.
brawn: Chandler said Joey brought the brawn while he brought the sarcasm to the friendship.
breach: Ross said the breach in museum security meant anyone could sneak in after hours.
breeding: Phoebe claimed her family was known for breeding musical talent, mostly on her side.
brithplace: Ross got emotional talking about his brithplace, the city where he grew up as a kid.
brooch: Rachel pinned a fancy brooch on her coat and said it was the height of fashion.
brutish: Chandler said Joey's brutish way of eating pizza made Monica want to leave the room.
bucktooth: Joey wore a fake bucktooth for an audition and committed to the role way too hard.
bulge: Ross spotted a bulge in his jacket and realized he'd been carrying a fossil all day.
bulk: Monica bought snacks in bulk, then organized them alphabetically in her tiny pantry.
bulldoze: Chandler said he'd bulldoze the whole neighborhood for free parking if anyone let him.
bulletin: There was a bulletin on the Central Perk board about a lost cat, and Phoebe took it personally.
bully: Joey stood up to a bully bothering Rachel at the coffee shop and felt heroic.
bumble: Chandler watched Joey bumble through his lines at rehearsal and tried not to laugh.
buoyant: Phoebe felt buoyant after writing a brand-new verse of Smelly Cat on the spot.
burdensome: Monica said cleaning up after Joey was the most burdensome chore in the apartment.
burgle: Joey worried someone would burgle his apartment, then realized he owned nothing of value.
burro: Phoebe said she once rode a burro up a mountain and sang the whole way there.
burrs: Ross got burrs stuck all over his sweater during a nature walk and complained loudly.
bury: Chandler wanted to bury the hatchet with Joey over the last slice of pizza.
bush: Monica trimmed the bush outside the window because it was blocking her view of the street.
bustle: Rachel loved the bustle of the fashion district, all the rushing and the pretty clothes.
cabbie: Chandler argued with a cabbie over the fare while Joey cheerfully paid double.
cacophony: Monica called the sound of everyone talking over each other an unbearable cacophony.
cactus: Phoebe kept a cactus on the windowsill because it needed almost no care from her.
calamitous: Chandler called the dinner calamitous, mostly because Ross burned the dessert again.
camouflage: Joey bought camouflage pants so he could hide from Monica when it was chore time.
canal: Ross explained how a canal connects two bodies of water, and Joey fell asleep instantly.
canary: Phoebe said her uncle kept a canary that sang better than she did, which she doubted.
cannonball: Joey did a cannonball into the bathtub and soaked the entire bathroom floor.
canopy: Monica hung a canopy over the balcony to make her little space feel fancy.
canton: Ross pointed to a tiny canton on the map and pronounced it completely wrong.
capsize: Chandler said his canoe would capsize instantly if Joey came along for the ride.
captivity: Phoebe said animals in captivity made her sad, so she freed her goldfish into a pond.
cardiovascular: Monica led a cardiovascular workout so intense that Chandler had to lie down after.
cargo: Joey packed his cargo shorts with snacks for a long day of auditions.
carousel: Ross insisted on riding the carousel three times, which embarrassed everyone at the park.
casualty: Chandler said the first casualty of Monica's cooking was always his stomach.
catchy: Phoebe's Smelly Cat was so catchy that everyone hummed it for the rest of the day.
catwalk: Rachel practiced her walk for the catwalk in the living room while everyone watched.
cautious: Monica was cautious about letting Joey near her freshly baked pie and hid it away.
cavalry: Joey said he'd be the cavalry and save the party, but he just ate all the chips.
cavern: Ross explained that a cavern is a big cave, then got lost looking for his flashlight.
ceasefire: Monica and Rachel called a ceasefire in their fight over the last slice of cheesecake.
celestial: Ross pointed at a celestial body in the sky and started naming every constellation.
cello: Phoebe said she once tried to play the cello but kept knocking it over with her guitar.
cement: Chandler said Monica's old leftovers were like cement stuck to the bottom of the fridge.
cenozoic: Ross explained the Cenozoic era so enthusiastically that Joey actually paid attention.
centipede: Phoebe found a centipede in her apartment and gently carried it outside to freedom.
cerebral concussion: Ross claimed Joey gave him a cerebral concussion with a pillow, which was very dramatic.
cerulean: Rachel said her favorite color was cerulean, a fancy word for a nice shade of blue.
cesspool: Chandler called the guys' fridge a cesspool of old takeout and refused to open it.
chaperone: Monica agreed to chaperone a school dance and immediately started organizing the snacks.
chasm: Joey said the chasm between him and his acting dreams was huge, then took a nap.
checkmate: Chandler beat Ross at chess and shouted checkmate so loudly the whole coffee shop stared.
cheetah: Ross said a cheetah runs faster than anything, which made Joey want one as a pet.
childcare: Monica offered free childcare for Ben and turned it into a spotless, scheduled activity.
chill out: Chandler told Ross to chill out after he freaked over a scratch on one fossil.
chitchat: Rachel enjoyed some friendly chitchat at Central Perk before heading to her big meeting.
chore: Monica made doing the dishes a chore everyone shared, though she rewashed everything.
chromatic: Ross explained the chromatic scale to Phoebe, who just played Smelly Cat even louder.
chronic: Chandler said his chronic lateness was a personality trait, not a flaw.
chrysalis: Phoebe watched a butterfly break out of its chrysalis and wrote a whole song about it.
churning: Monica was churning butter by hand, because of course she had to do it the hard way.
cinematic: Joey called his own audition cinematic, even though he forgot every single line.
cite: Ross loved to cite scientific papers at dinner, which made everyone groan in unison.
clashing: Rachel said the clashing colors on the Central Perk couch were a crime against decorating.
cliche: Chandler said falling for Monica in a coffee shop was a cliche, then smiled at her.
climate: Phoebe worried about the climate so much that she hugged a tree outside Central Perk.
clincher: The clincher for Rachel's Ralph Lauren job was her amazing portfolio, and she spilled nothing on it.
clockwise: Monica told everyone to stir the batter clockwise, because she had very strong opinions.
clownfish: Ross showed everyone a clownfish at the aquarium and got weirdly emotional about it.
cluck: Phoebe made a cluck sound every time she passed the chicken stand at the market.
cluelessness: Chandler said Joey's cluelessness about laundry was both impressive and a little scary.
coalition: Monica and Phoebe formed a coalition to get Ross to stop talking about dinosaurs.
coarse: Rachel complained that the cheap fabric felt coarse against her skin.
coatings: Monica scrubbed the stove until all the greasy coatings were completely gone.
cob: Phoebe fed a cob of corn to a duck at the park and made a whole song about it.
cockatoo: Ross said a cockatoo can mimic speech, and Joey tried to teach it his soap opera lines.
coerce: Chandler tried to coerce Joey into paying for lunch with sad puppy eyes.
coexist: Phoebe said cats and dogs can coexist, then showed everyone her strange pet arrangement.
cognitive: Ross explained the cognitive benefits of coffee, mostly as an excuse for a fourth cup.
collaborate: Rachel and Monica tried to collaborate on dinner and fought over every single detail.
collator: Chandler made up a job title, calling himself the official collator of pizza orders.
collision: Joey walked into a collision with the door while trying to impress a girl.
colossal: Ross found a colossal fossil and couldn't stop telling everyone how huge it was.
combustion: Chandler said Monica's cooking involved spontaneous combustion, though she disagreed.
commissioner: Ross bragged he'd once met the commissioner of the museum, which no one believed.
commodity: Monica said a spotless apartment was the most valuable commodity in their friendship.
compaction: Ross explained the compaction of soil, and Joey stared blankly into the distance.
companion: Chandler joked his only companion in life was his sarcasm and a cold cup of coffee.
compassion: Phoebe showed endless compassion to the pigeons outside Central Perk every morning.
compatible: Rachel insisted she and Ross were totally compatible, despite the whole dinosaur thing.
compel: The smell of Monica's cookies would compel Joey to come running from three floors away.
compelling: Chandler found the dinosaur documentary so compelling he forgot to make any jokes.
compliance: Monica demanded total compliance with her cleaning schedule, no exceptions ever.
compose: Phoebe tried to compose a new song about a pigeon, but it turned into Smelly Cat again.
compost: Phoebe kept a compost bin on the balcony, which annoyed Monica's sense of order.
comprehension: Joey nodded as if in comprehension, though he had no idea what Ross was saying.
comrade: Chandler called Joey his comrade in laziness on the couch every single afternoon.
concise: Monica told Ross to be concise, because his dinosaur stories ran way too long.
condiment: Joey grabbed every condiment in the fridge and poured them all over his fries.
confinement: Chandler said the tiny closet felt like confinement, but Joey called it cozy.
congressional: Ross rambled about a congressional hearing on dinosaurs that had never happened.
conscience: Joey ate the last cookie, then his conscience made him confess to Monica.
consecutive: Monica won five consecutive rounds of the board game and wouldn't stop gloating.
consensual: Chandler joked that renting a movie had to be a consensual decision among everyone.
consent: Rachel asked for Joey's consent before borrowing his favorite sweater for the day.
consequently: Ross ate too much Thanksgiving turkey and consequently fell asleep right on the couch.
conservancy: Phoebe volunteered with a wildlife conservancy and sang to the birds all day.
conspiracy: Chandler claimed the missing pizza was a conspiracy and accused everyone at once.
constipation: Joey blamed his constipation on eating six pizzas the night before.
constitute: Ross argued that two fossils did not constitute a collection, but Joey disagreed.
constitution: Chandler said his morning coffee was the only thing that strengthened his constitution.
consulate: Rachel insisted she'd once visited a consulate, but couldn't say which country.
contaminate: Monica warned Joey not to contaminate her kitchen with his dirty sneakers.
contempt: Chandler looked at the saggy old couch with contempt, then sat on it anyway.
contingency: Monica had a contingency plan for every possible dinner disaster, and then some.
contradiction: Ross's story was full of contradiction, and even he got confused halfway through.
contrary: Contrary to what Joey believed, his bank account wouldn't just refill itself.
converge: All six friends would converge at Central Perk every morning around the same time.
convict: Joey swore he'd never convict a friend of eating his food, then caught Chandler red-handed.
conviction: Chandler argued with such conviction that everyone believed his made-up story.
coordinate: Monica tried to coordinate everyone's outfits for the party and gave up in five minutes.
coot: Phoebe pointed at an old coot on the bench and said he reminded her of her grandpa.
cooty: Joey called the mystery thing in the fridge a cooty and refused to touch it.
cope: Chandler said he could barely cope with Monica's impossibly high cleaning standards.
copter: Ross said he once flew in a copter over the ocean and got motion sick immediately.
cornerstone: Monica said trust was the cornerstone of friendship, right before hiding her good china.
corral: Joey tried to corral everyone into one room for a group photo, and it was chaos.
corridor: Ross chased a runaway model dinosaur down the corridor of the museum.
corrupt: Chandler joked the vending machine was corrupt because it ate his dollar.
cortex: Ross explained that the cerebral cortex handles thinking, which made Joey's head hurt.
cosmetic: Rachel said her new makeup was purely cosmetic, but she loved it anyway.
council: Monica called a household council to settle who should do the dishes.
councillor: Phoebe claimed she knew a councillor who could fix anything, but nobody asked how.
countless: Monica reorganized her spices countless times, convinced the order somehow mattered.
courtesan: Joey auditioned for a movie about a courtesan and had no idea what the word meant.
cove: Ross showed everyone a quiet cove on the map and started planning a fake research trip.
crackerjack: Monica called Joey a crackerjack at eating and nothing else, which he took as praise.
crackpot: Chandler said the guy's theory was pure crackpot nonsense, then secretly agreed with it.
crapy: Joey said the crapy movie he watched was the worst thing ever, then he cried anyway.
crate: Monica stacked a crate of oranges by the door and labeled it with a tiny sticky note.
crave: Chandler said he'd crave Monica's lasagna even if he had to walk ten miles for it.
crawlspace: Joey hid in the crawlspace to avoid chores and got a spider on his head.
crayon: Phoebe drew a picture of Smelly Cat with a crayon and hung it above her bed.
